question: In which year was India’s first operational six-lane expressway, the approximately 95 km long Mumbai–Pune Expressway, inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Mumbai–Pune Expressway** is India's **first operational six-lane concrete expressway**. It was inaugurated in the year **2002**.
 
• The expressway spans approximately **95 kilometers** and connects the two major cities of **Mumbai** and **Pune** in Maharashtra.
 
• The construction of the expressway was undertaken to address the growing traffic congestion between Mumbai and Pune, which are important economic and cultural hubs of Maharashtra.
 
• **It was officially opened to the public in 2002**. The expressway was built to meet international standards and improve travel efficiency and safety.* Hence, the correct year is **2002**.*
